scripts.emulators: JAVA_HOME=$(ls -d $PWD/.tools/jdk-*/Contents/Home) PATH=$(ls -d $PWD/.tools/jdk-*/Contents/Home)/bin:$PATH firebase emulators:start --project demo-ptp --only firestore,auth
scripts.test:rules: JAVA_HOME=$(ls -d $PWD/.tools/jdk-*/Contents/Home) PATH=$(ls -d $PWD/.tools/jdk-*/Contents/Home)/bin:$PATH firebase emulators:exec --project demo-ptp --only firestore 'vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.ts'
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting,firestore:rules
scripts.e2e:emulator: JAVA_HOME=$(ls -d $PWD/.tools/jdk-*/Contents/Home) PATH=$(ls -d $PWD/.tools/jdk-*/Contents/Home)/bin:$PATH firebase emulators:exec --project demo-ptp --only firestore,auth 'sh scripts/e2e-emulator.sh'
